copy.title: The MrBeast Money File
copy.desc: An interactive, fully sourced map of MrBeast’s family: who does what in the business, which of his companies you can buy, and the money on the public record.
copy.eyebrow: File #022 · MrBeast’s family · Data as of
copy.h1: The world’s biggest YouTuber has a family. We followed the money.
copy.lede: Who’s who, what each of them does in the business, whether you can buy into his companies, and the money on the public record. Every number links to its source.
copy.familyLede: Tap anyone to open their file: what they do, what’s on the record, and where every fact comes from. Only family members who are public figures are shown.
copy.investLede: None of the companies on this map trade on the stock market. All four are privately owned.
copy.moneyLede: There’s no Forbes or Bloomberg net worth for Jimmy, so there’s no family money ladder here. Forbes does estimate his yearly earnings, and investors valued Beast Industries at about $5 billion.
copy.recordLede: The money that shows up in investor documents, a company press release and Forbes’s estimates. Reporting and filings, not guesses.
copy.trailLede: From a 13-year-old’s first upload in 2012 to a company valued at about $5 billion.

summary.t: Jimmy’s older brother. Jimmy shot his early YouTube videos on his brother’s hand-me-down laptop.

Runs the most-subscribed channel on YouTube. He founded Beast Industries, the company behind his videos, Feastables chocolate, Lunchly lunch kits and the Viewstats analytics tool. He also makes the Beast Games show for Amazon’s Prime Video.

worth.none: No Forbes or Bloomberg net worth estimate. Forbes tracks his yearly earnings instead (see below).
worth.by: Forbes 2026 Top Creators list (earnings, not net worth)

owns.t: Founder. Forbes reported in November 2022 that he was the sole owner of his studio and was looking to sell a small stake. By March 2025 the company had raised more than $450 million from investors, Bloomberg reported. Bloomberg didn’t report his current stake.
Launched in January 2022. Beast Industries is the majority owner. It had about $250 million in sales in 2024 and more than $20 million in profit, according to documents sent to investors.
A joint venture with Logan Paul and KSI, launched in September 2024. The kits come with Feastables chocolate and a Prime drink.

Started in December 2020 as a delivery-only brand, cooked in existing kitchens that licensed the menu through Virtual Dining Concepts. Forbes said it had $70 million in sales in 2021 and his stake brought him $3 million.

record.t: Forbes estimates he earned $300 million in its 2026 Top Creators ranking. He has been No. 1 every year since the list began, five years in a row.

Alpha Wave led a $300 million round in 2024 that valued Beast Industries at about $5 billion, up from about $1.5 billion a few months earlier, Bloomberg reported. In January 2026, Bitmine Immersion Technologies announced a $200 million equity investment.

Amazon ordered Beast Games for Prime Video in March 2024, with 1,000 contestants and a $5 million prize. The deal was reported at $100 million. He later called it a “poor financial decision,” saying he lost tens of millions of dollars on the show.

facts.t: Uploaded his first YouTube video in February 2012, at age 13, as “MrBeast6000.”
His channel became the most-subscribed on YouTube on June 2, 2024, passing T-Series.
In 2022 Forbes estimated he was worth some $500 million and said his videos were typically made on budgets of $1.5 million to $3 million.
Beast Industries bought Step, a money app for teens, in February 2026.

summary.t: South African author, YouTuber and Twitch streamer, known online as TheaBeasty. She and Jimmy began dating in 2022.

facts.t: Jimmy proposed on Christmas Day 2024 and announced the engagement on January 1, 2025.
They married in July 2026 on Richard Branson’s Necker Island in the British Virgin Islands, in front of 70 friends and family.

summary.t: A military veteran. After Jimmy was born she served as a military prison warden near Mannheim, Germany, then was stationed at Fort Leavenworth in Kansas.

record.t: Serves as chief compliance officer of MrBeast LLC and manages the company’s spending and contracts.

facts.t: When Jimmy dropped out of community college, she made him move out. “Not wanting to enable him, she kicked him out of the house,” Forbes reported.

companies.name: Beast Industries
companies.t: Holding company for his videos, Feastables, Lunchly, Viewstats and licensing. Valued at about $5 billion in a 2024 round; Bitmine added $200 million in January 2026. It bought the teen money app Step in February 2026. No public shares.

companies.name: Feastables
companies.t: Chocolate and snacks, announced in January 2022. About $250 million in sales and more than $20 million in profit in 2024.

companies.name: Lunchly
companies.who: Jimmy, Logan Paul and KSI (joint venture)
companies.t: Packaged lunch kits launched in September 2024 to compete with Lunchables. Private.

companies.t: Delivery brand launched in December 2020; $70 million in sales in 2021, per Forbes.
